startingSource: 132 ordinary live VM files, copied directly after matching the expected manifest digest; rejected SLRU source is never restored or used
policy: On existing miss victim work only, minimize estimated_build_work / max(1, snapshot_work - last_used) among occupied unpinned unselected slots.
cost: max(1, body_len + 2*validated_Counts.locals + 2*validated_Counts.instructions + 2*validated_Counts.targets), checked u64 conversions, doubles and sums; ordinary Counts.bytes error is checked first, then cost is precomputed/precharged before existing entry admission/build
costScope: A conservative repeat-build logical-credit estimate. It omits parameter/signature checks, local-group overhead and control patching. Counts and body length are immutable proof-backed scan/build inputs, never function popularity or source syntax authorization.
ranking: One fixed work-clock snapshot per victim scan; checked u64 age subtraction, clamp zero age to one, checked u128 cross products. Ratio ties prefer older last_used, then lower slot index. Selected plan bits, pinned and empty slots cannot rank. Memory pressure reruns the same policy for each necessary victim.
failure: Zero stored cost, future timestamp or arithmetic error fails closed before resident mutation. Original earlier function/pin/identity/scan/entry-size/capacity/no-victim precedence is retained. No new fallible operation follows successful decoded ownership before existing resident publication.
hits: Existing hit branch, resident lookup, final pin publication and release bodies remain byte-identical. No hit-time scan, metadata read/write, counter, promotion, allocation or ticket.

rank: extra8credits before each eligible rank block: cost read and nonzero validation; recency read with checked age/clamp; candidate preparation; best Option probe; left checked product; right checked product; ratio/tie comparison; conditional local-rank publication
creation: extra12credits before estimate/build admission: body plus3count reads/conversions;3checked doubles;3checked sums; clamp; eventual resident field write
work.model: Fixed authored logical operation groups, not a CPU instruction, elapsed-time or physical-stack measurement. Conservative full blocks remain charged on first-candidate or failing paths.

memory: Complete enlarged resident slots and existing permanent transfer inventories are admitted before existing allocations. Three additional disjoint complete CostRetentionInventory values cover every new named local, parameter, closure/reborrow, checked-result and caller/return object without reusing another owner or inventory's slack. Existing sizeof-based resident transfer rows grow automatically.
decisionBoundary: Finite failures/regressions are retained. Only root can select any separately reviewed same-budget actual-target attempt. No such attempt or integration is implied.
